notes.title: CHAOS Update - 1.9 - News About 2.0
notes.content:
Hey Chaos Players, this update is rather small, but we're not wanting to leave the game broken for an extended period while we work on 2.0!

Ps. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/e9Wu5Xc]Discord[/url]! come talk to me, see your ideas in 2.0 (:

Today's update is bug fixes, we can't name most of them, but they're there, you'll be especially happy to know the exit button works! Also located a few issues with multiplayer things sending too much data etc, but that's about it, Ryster redid sliding, and now you keep the speed you entered with, AND you slide whichever direct you had momentum in, also ground slam has been disabled.

In essence, 2.0 will be a new season, with the following planned content:

- New Character Model
- Complete Animation Rework
- Voice lines For Characters
- Announcer
- Server Settings
- Anti-Cheat Enhancements
- Reworked Weapon Pool and Balance
- Groundup Map Reworks
- Groundup GUI Rework
- More I Can't Share Yet (:

This will take approximately 2-3 months, in the meantime, the game will be in a polished state, with maybe a map or two released, on the side.

Thanks for the support!

- Frinky

notes.title: CHAOS Weekly Update - 1.2
notes.content:
Hello chaos players! Thank you for the support over launch, I'm happy to announce that I will be doing weekly major updates, these will contain lots of goodies for you to try out, here are this week's notes:

[url= https://discord.gg/e9Wu5Xc]FRINKYGAMES Discord[/url]

[i](NOTE: To Players Struggling to Join Servers, One-Click Will Do, I Promise, It's Just Connecting You, There Is Now a Notification When You're Joining, so That Should Help.)

(NOTE 2: If You Find Yourself Randomly Disconnected Midgame, This Is Likely Due to the Host Leaving the Match, This Will Cause Your Client to Well, Break, and Will Require a Restart of the Game to Reconnect or Create Servers!)[/i]

Balance:
- MK-III Fire Delay Increased From 0.7 to 0.85
- Semi Shotgun Capacity Increased From 5 to 8
- M4A1 Damage Increased From 13 to 15

Additions:
- Added AI Arena
- Added Disable Map Cycling Option
- Added Icey Arena Map
- Added Kriss Vector (SMG)
[strike]- Added Server Passwords[/strike] This Feature Is Postponed Till Further Notice.
- Added Update Whiteboard
- Added New Lobby

- Fixes
- [b]Fixed: *MAJOR* Performance Issue Involving Grenades Lowering Frames/Lagging Servers (OMG)[/b] 
- Fixed: Team Body Colour Disappearing On Respawn
- Fixed: Team Death Match End Screen Displaying Wrong Info
- Fixed: Changing Setting Fast Mode To Off Caused Post Processing To Break
- Fixed: Game Launching In VR Mode

The Kriss Vector:
Fire Rate: 0.075 Seconds Per Round
Base Damage: 14
Ammo Capacity: 13
Vertical Recoil: 0.2 - 0.4
Horizontal Recoil: 0.5 - -0.5
Destruction Damage: 1.0
Bullet Spread: Yes
Bullet Spread Amount: 600 
Crosshair: Standard

(Btw I plan to profile all guns eventually) 

Icey Arena Map:
Description: An Arena With A Very Slippery Floor, With Buildings On Either Side! Make Your Moves Count, As Its Hard To Turn Back!

Final Notes: I plan on improving networking further next weekly update, with less focus on content, you will also most likely see some more arena mode features, as its inclusion greatly expands the games life span.
